verses.1: And these are the daughters of Esau; he is Edom.
verses.2: Eshua took his wives from the women of Canaan: Adah, daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Ahzi, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon the Hivite.
verses.3: And Bathsheba, the daughter of Jezebel, was one of the prophets.
verses.4: And Adah gave birth to Eliphaz. And Beshmata gave birth to Reuel.
verses.5: And Ohlivama gave birth to Yeush, and Yealam, and Korach. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to her in the land of Canaan.
verses.6: And Esau took his wives, his children, his daughters, all the souls in his house, his possessions, and all his animals. He also took away all the goods he had acquired in the land of Canaan. Then he went to the land that was behind Jacob, his brother.
verses.7: For their possessions were so numerous when they lived together, that the land could not carry them all away from their homes.
verses.8: And Esau sat on Mount Seir. Esau was a descendant of Adam.
verses.9: And these were the daughters of Esau, my father Adam, on Mount Seir.
verses.10: These are the names of the sons of Esau: Eliphaz, son of Adah; Esau’s wife’s name was Reuel, son of Bashmet. This is also the name of Esau’s other son.
verses.11: And the sons of Eliphaz were Timan, Omer, Tzefo, and Gatam.
verses.12: And Philo was a son of Eliphaz. Philo gave birth to Amalek to Eliphaz. These were the sons of Adah, daughters of Esau.
verses.13: And these sons of Rahu were blessed and radiant. They were the sons of Beshmat, the wife of Esau.
verses.14: And these were the sons of Aholibma, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zebulun. She was the wife of Esau. Esau gave birth to Yeush, Yaalam, and Korach.
verses.15: These are the sons of Esau, the sons of Eliphaz. They were buried in the grave of Esau. There were one hundred men, one hundred women, one hundred children, and one hundred horses.
verses.16: Aluf-Korach, Aluf Ga’tam, Aluf Amalek… These are the sons of Eliphaz. They live in the land of Edom.
verses.17: And these are the sons of Reuvel, sons of Esau: one thousand; one thousand rose; one thousand shamah; one thousand Mizah. These are the sons of Reuvel in the land of Edom. These are also the sons of Bashmat, daughters of Esau.
verses.18: And these are the sons of Aholibma: the wife of Esau. There were one hundred of them; one hundred who would die; one hundred who would be destroyed. These are the sons of Aholibma, the daughter of Anah, the wife of Esau.
verses.19: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their descendants. He is Adonai.
verses.20: These are the children of She’ir, who dwell on the earth. They are Lotan, Shuval, Zevan, and Anah.
verses.21: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan – these are the sons of Shechor in the land of Edom.
verses.22: And the sons of Lotan were Hur and Yehim. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.23: And these are the sons of Shobal: Elan, Manachah, Eibal, Shaphur, and Onam.
verses.24: And these were the sons of Zebulun and Ayyah. He, Anah, found them in the desert during his journey. He took the oxen for Zebulun, his father.
verses.25: And these are the sons of Anah: Shun and Ahribama, daughter of Anah.
verses.26: And these are the sons of Dishan: Hemedan, Esban, Yithran, and Khran.
verses.27: These are the children of Ezer, Bilhan, Zaven, and Akhan.
verses.28: These are the sons of Dishan: Uzzah and Aran.
verses.29: These are the seven heavens: one thousand, one thousand more, one thousand more, one thousand more, one thousand more.
verses.30: One thousand lips, one thousand eyes, one thousand ears. These are the ears of the people in the land of She’ir.
verses.31: And these are the kings who ruled over the land of Edom before the king of Israel.
verses.32: And Adam ruled over Balaam, son of Beor. The name of his city was Dinahava.
verses.33: And Balak died. Yovav, son of Zerach, became his successor as king.
verses.34: And Yovav died, and Kusham became his king from the land of Timan.
verses.35: And Chusham died. His successor was Hadad, who killed Midian in the field of Moab. The name of his city was Avit.
verses.36: And they both died. Then Shamlah from Masrekah became their king.
verses.37: And Shamlah died, and Shaul became king from the banks of the river.
verses.38: Shaul died, and Hanan, son of Akbor, became his king.
verses.39: And Hanan’s son, Hadar, died. Under his rule, the city was called Pauv. His wife’s name was Mehitabel, daughter of Metred.
verses.40: And these are the names of the sons of Esau, according to their families and their locations: Elul, Timna, Elopah, Jaalon, and Dabel.
verses.41: One Aholibama, one Elah, one Pinoon.
verses.42: One hundred kenz, one hundred timan, one hundred mivtsar.
verses.43: One thousand Magdiel, one thousand their cities. These are the people of Adam who live in their own land. This was done by Adam’s father.
